newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower on NCD maturation.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates closed lower on Wednesday following the maturation of T$65 billion negotiable certificates of deposit, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate ended at 6.027 percent against Tuesday's 6.036 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 6.10 percent against 6.10-6.15.
Dealers said they expected the rates to remain stable as the market's excess liquidity likely would be mopped up by emerging payroll demand.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0870-0875 percent against 6.0875. -- James Lin (5080815)
